title: GraphTraverseResponse
description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag graph traverse` on stdout as a single JSON line. BFS traversal from a starting entity up to a configurable depth. With `--fuzzy` (v1.1.05), `from` is the resolved canonical entity name and may differ from the CLI `--from` argument.

relation.description: Relationship label between the two entities.

direction.description: Direction relative to the traversal source.

depth.description: BFS depth level at which this hop was discovered.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

from.description: Canonical name of the starting entity. Equals the `--from` argument on exact match; with `--fuzzy` (v1.1.05) this is the resolved canonical name and may differ from the CLI argument.

hops.description: Ordered list of hops discovered during BFS traversal.
